title: HTML Basics
description: HTML structure, elements, semantic tags, and document fundamentals.
fullDescription: Understanding HTML document structure, semantic elements, headings, text formatting, links, lists, forms basics, and media elements.

title: HTML Tables, Forms & CSS Basics
description: HTML tables, forms, input types, validation, and CSS fundamentals.
fullDescription: Working with HTML tables and forms, using different input types and validation attributes, and learning CSS application methods, selectors, cascade, and internal page navigation.

title: CSS Fundamentals
description: CSS selectors, colors, typography, backgrounds, borders, spacing, and positioning.
fullDescription: Learning CSS selectors, colors, fonts, backgrounds, borders, margin, padding, the box model, box-sizing, positioning, z-index, and semantic HTML layout elements.

title: CSS Display, Transforms & Flexbox
description: CSS display behavior, visibility, transitions, transforms, and Flexbox layouts.
fullDescription: Understanding display, visibility, opacity, overflow, CSS transitions and transforms, hover effects, and building flexible layouts using Flexbox alignment, wrapping, sizing, and ordering.

title: Advanced CSS & Bootstrap
description: CSS variables, pseudo-elements, animations, advanced selectors, and Bootstrap fundamentals.
fullDescription: Creating CSS animations, using pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements, working with CSS variables, gradients, box shadows, advanced selectors, responsive media queries, and building layouts and components with Bootstrap.

title: JavaScript Fundamentals
description: JavaScript basics, DOM manipulation, data types, conditions, operators, functions, and loops.
fullDescription: Learning the fundamentals of JavaScript, including variables, primitive data types, type conversion, DOM element selection, conditions, comparison and logical operators, switch statements, functions, and different types of loops.

title: JavaScript Functions, Objects, Arrays & DOM
description: JavaScript functions, objects, arrays, BOM, DOM manipulation, and events.
fullDescription: Learning how to create reusable functions, work with objects and arrays, interact with the browser using the BOM, manipulate HTML and CSS through the DOM, change attributes and classes, and handle user events.

title: Modern JavaScript (ES6+)
description: ES6 features including let, const, template literals, spread operator, destructuring, and modern array methods.
fullDescription: Learn modern JavaScript syntax and features such as block-scoped variables, template literals, default parameters, spread operator, arrow functions, destructuring, and advanced array methods like filter, find, map, and forEach.

title: APIs & Asynchronous JavaScript
description: AJAX, APIs, Fetch API, Promises, Async/Await, and working with remote data.
fullDescription: Learn how web applications communicate with APIs using AJAX concepts, XMLHttpRequest, Fetch API, Promises, callback functions, Async/Await, JSON parsing, and dynamic content rendering with JavaScript.

title: NoSQL & MongoDB Fundamentals
description: NoSQL databases, MongoDB architecture, BSON, and shell CRUD operations.
fullDescription: Understand NoSQL database paradigms, ACID vs BASE consistency models, and master MongoDB core concepts including documents, BSON, shell queries, operators, projections, array modifications, and aggregation basics.
